description: This file defines the Subscription class within the Opencart admin area. It handles subscription-related operations such as adding history entries and processing transactions, including sending email notifications for subscription status updates and cancellations.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription-related actions in the admin mail subsystem, including history updates and transaction handling.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Handles adding history entries to subscriptions and sending notification emails based on subscription status changes.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Manages processing of subscription transactions, especially cancellations, and sends related notification emails.
